text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After training, I return to my office
when...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oye! Get down from that tree! If
somebody sees
ya—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: El, is that bird stalking you again?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?! F-Flash?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've noticed that bird is often
around El,
and from what I've heard...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Haha! Wow, it's so weird, right? After all, why would a condor take a likin' to lil ol' me?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But people'll get scared if they see it
hangin'
around, so go on, you! Hurry
back to the dor—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uh, I mean... G-get back to the forest!
I've tried
to get it to go a million times,
but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I understand the situation now. I have an
idea.
choice_data_list: 言うことを聞かない、と？
choice_data_list_en: So they won't listen to you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash approaches the tree where
the bird is
perched.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hear me, nameless bird. This is not your
home.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There is no hope of food, and those here
will try
to drive you away... You will find
only hardship
here.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We do not wish for you to suffer such a
fate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if moved to the core by Eishin's
words, the bird
lets out a
heart-wrenching cry.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I knew you would agree. Now, go... Fly
to where
you will be truly safe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flap, flap, flap!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whaaa?! It's flown off to its nest! I'd
yelled and
yelled, but it wouldn't even
budge for me!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. My parents taught me that
all animals
have a heart.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
They said it is better to reason with them
than to
scold them. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I had the feeling it would be easy to
convey my
thoughts to that bird, and
that it would listen to
what I said.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! You sound like you know a lot
about how
to get your feelings across to
others!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Flash, you gotta teach me your secrets! I
never
know when I'll run into Ma—er, my
feathered
admirer again, after all!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Sure. I wouldn't mind that, but I'm not
sure I can
explain how I do it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I shall add you to tomorrow's
schedule.
choice_data_list: コツを教えてあげたら？
choice_data_list_en: Maybe have them shadow you for a day?
Why don't you give them some tips?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. Allow me to go over
today's
agenda with you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We arrive at the track in five minutes
and ten
seconds. After twenty minutes
and fifty seconds
of warm-ups, there
should be a headwind just as
we start
running laps.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thus, it will be possible to duplicate
final straight
conditions in which there
will be no shelter from
the wind.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You've not only planned everything
down to the
second but even thought
about weather
patterns?! Talk 'bout
bein' precise!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That concludes our run. Let's relocate to
the
gymnasium in five minutes and
perform pull-ups
on the power rack for
twenty-three minutes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa... How're you still so full of
energy after
all that sprintin'?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué?! Are ya really eatin' natto?! That's
an
exchange student's worst nightmare!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Lunch is fuel for the afternoon's activities. Consuming ample nutrition is a must. No exceptions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa continues watching
Eishin Flash
for the rest of the day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Phew... And with the power rack
finished... that
concludes today's
training.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe this is what a day in your
life is like!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Everything was so awesome! The way she

schedules, her trainin' regimen, her
nutrition
management... It all leaves me
speechless!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But I bet Mambo was real impressed by
how stoic
and perfect you are, which is
why he listened to
ya!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Urk! Uh, um... Yeah, who is Mambo? Haha! What even is a "mambo," am I right? Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems El Condor Pasa learned quite a
few
things today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hm... I think I have one, then.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I believe that you need to convey your
feelings
with love.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: L-love?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In order to have an earnest conversation
with
another, you must face the other
party as an
equal.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's necessary to value and respect your partner, and to talk with them rather than at them.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And when it comes to respecting and
valuing your
speaking partner, you must
have—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Love!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thinkin' 'bout it, all I ever did was tell
him "no"
and never tried to listen to
what he had to say...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll give bein' more lovin' a try
so I can
keep Mambo happy an' healthy!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Agh! Uhhh! Um, um!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, like m-mambo dancin'! I'm
gonna try to
reason with that condor
with as much love an'
passion as a
mambo dance!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A wonderful mindset. I wish you the best
of luck
opening a line of communication
with that bird.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems El Condor Pasa learned quite a
few
things today.
